# A task whose criteria are boxes

## Goal

Say what this task is for, in one sentence a reader can disagree with.

## Requirements

- One requirement, stated so that a test could be written against it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The first criterion is a checkbox line, which is the whole point of this file.
- [x] The second one shows that a ticked box counts too.

## Out of Scope

- Anything this task does not do.
